description: Search the Replo template library (sites, pages, sections, skills, plans, brand kits, and reference guides) by id, slug, type, or search. Search is semantic: describe the job, e.g. "supplement product page buy box with subscribe-and-save". Returns metadata and previewUrls: screenshots, or for sites and sections, pages that render the item. When a top match's first preview is a picture, it also comes back as an image. To start a site from a site match, pass its slug as create_site's template. To add a page or section match to a site, call create_site_page for a new route or edit_site_page for an existing one, and ask Replo's agent to install the item by its slug and type. Before creating or editing a site or page, read the building-replo-pages skill (call skills with name "building-replo-pages").

id.description: Registry item ID to look up.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 1 to 20. Default 5.

search.description: What the item should do or look like, up to 200 characters.

slug.description: Registry item slug to look up.

type.description: Only return this kind of item.

name: find_registry_items
title: Find registry items
